name: English
notes: The language of the board and national schools (no Gaelic provision in the 1872 Scottish Act), so the language a schooled man reads and writes.

name: Welsh
notes: 54.0% of people in Wales aged 3+ spoke Welsh in 1891 (L§2.1); shares per area in language_rates.json.

name: Scottish Gaelic
notes: 6.2% of Scotland in 1881, 60-75% in the Highland counties, under 2% in the football counties (L§3.1).

name: Irish
notes: 23.9% (1881) and 19.2% (1891) of the area of the later Irish state; highest in Connacht (L§3.3).

name: German
notes: The largest European-born group in England and Wales in 1891 (about 50,000, L§4.3-4.4).

name: Yiddish
notes: Jews from the Russian Empire, about 120,000 settled by 1914 (Leeds, Manchester, London; L§4.5).

name: Lithuanian
notes: A few hundred to about 7,000 in the Lanarkshire and Midlothian pits, 1886-1914 (L§4.7).
